name: Daniel Freund - § 117 - Am 50
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 117. Notes with concern that the Commission allocated EUR 8 million in 2024 and EUR 20,9 million in 2025, representing an increase of 160 %, for calls for proposals for the production of content on Union affairs by consortia of news media organisations, and that three media consortia currently receive Union funding; recalls that a free, independent and pluralistic press is a cornerstone of democratic accountability; stresses, however, that such funding risks creating structural financial dependency between media organisations that should serve as independent watchdogs and the institutions they cover; underlines that public trust in both media and EU institutions is undermined when journalists reporting on EU affairs receive direct or indirect funding from those institutions; calls on all EU institutions to cease direct funding of media production about EU affairs; further calls on the Commission, in cooperation with the Parliament and the Council, to establish a unified inter-institutional media transparency portal, easily accessible to the public, disclosing all media outlets receiving Union funds, including detailed data on sub-grants within consortia, so that citizens can identify the ultimate beneficiaries of Union media funding and verify that journalistic watchdogs remain transparent about their financial backing;
